scope: Ontology design and schema validation only

changes: Concise planning prompt and duplicate short-text removal

limitations: One fresh real model call and one identical cached rerun; this is not a controlled performance benchmark.
The baseline is a historical run. Provider load, runtime load, execution order and other conditions can affect elapsed time.
Effort, response schema and prompt changed together, so the observed difference cannot be attributed to effort alone.
Schema validation does not establish semantic accuracy or equivalence to the historical ontology.
Full evidence extraction and graph analysis were not run in this measurement.
The cached rerun avoids model calls for an identical validated design input; it does not predict the latency of new or changed inputs.
These results do not guarantee that other initial design calls complete in approximately 84 seconds.
